name: M7.QuerySectors.all_complete
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → F ∈ M7.QuerySectors.allSectors N
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
guidance: Choose normalizedFactors F as a submultiset via dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors. Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_prod_normalizedFactors and F.Monic identify its product with F. Preserve repeated factors; never replace factor multiset with a Finset before powerset. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.
